<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 4:8">Targ. Cant. IV, 8</cite>.—

<cite ref="Menachot 43a:14">Men. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>אינש צ׳ הוה וכ׳</he> he was a decorous man and would not take off his cloak the entire day; a. e.—Pl. <he>צְנִיעִין</he>; f. <cite ref="R00624"><he>צְנִיעָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="R00626"><he>צְנִיעָתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 38:8">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XXXVIII, 8</cite> <he>נשיא צ׳ דהוון צ׳ וכ׳</he> chaste women that lived in retirement &c. (h. text <he>הצבאות</he>); Y. I <cite ref="R00626"><he>צניעותא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 140b:15">Sabb. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>תיהוון צניען וכ׳</he> Ms. O. (ed. <he>תהוי צניעתן</he>, corr. acc.) be reserved even in the presence of your husbands.
